description: RESEAU - Débits_accès_Internet : ADSL_câble_Fibre is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Commune de Brocas. The data present the distribution of the number of premises (housing, businesses, public sites) by throughput class. They are displayed all technologies combined and by technology (ADSL, cable, FttH fiber). Coverage: Commune de Brocas. The portal shows the English title as "NETWORK - Internet_access_debits: ADSL_cable_Fibre" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Commune de Brocas. Its keywords include spatial-planning, fibre, housing, acces, internet, cable. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, JSON, SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
